# mimecast_dmarc_domain_groups (Data Source)

Read complete typed DMARC Analyzer domain groups with cursor pagination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_dmarc_domain_groups" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable DMARC domain-group inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `does_auto_include_org_subdomains` (Boolean) Whether organisational subdomains are included automatically.
- `domains_count` (Number) Number of domains currently included in the group.
- `id` (String) Domain-group ID.
- `include_domains_regex` (Set of String) Domain patterns included by a dynamic group.
- `include_domains_with_status` (String) Activity status used when automatically including domains.
- `included_domains` (Attributes List) Managed domains included in the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--included_domains))
- `name` (String) Domain-group name.
- `type` (String) Domain-group type.

<a id="nestedatt--items--included_domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.included_domains`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) Referenced domain name.
- `id` (String) Referenced object ID.
- `name` (String) Referenced object name.
